en.description:
Senior Front-End Engineer with 6+ years of experience building maintainable, high-performance web applications using React, TypeScript and modern front-end architectures.

Experienced leading engineering initiatives, mentoring developers and delivering products across marketing, education and SaaS environments, collaborating closely with product, design and engineering teams to create consistent and user-focused digital experiences.

Strong background in front-end architecture, component-driven development, performance optimization, accessibility and technical mentoring. Proven experience defining architectural standards, implementing code review processes and contributing to engineering scalability through testing standards and development best practices.

In addition to hands-on engineering, I also bring leadership and mentoring experience from previous roles as Technical Trainer and Programming Instructor, where I coached developers, structured onboarding processes and helped scale technical teams.

Core Stack: React.js, TypeScript, Next.js, JavaScript (ES6+), React Native, GraphQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, React Query, Git, CI/CD, Front-End Architecture and Performance Optimization.

es.description: Soy diseñador UX desde hace 8 años, creando interfaces amigables que se sienten naturales, intuitivas y fluidas en diferentes dispositivos. Me apasiona diseñar experiencias digitales que no solo se vean bien, sino que también funcionen sin esfuerzo, haciendo que las interacciones sean más suaves y agradables.

fr.description: Je suis designer UX depuis 8 ans, créant des interfaces conviviales qui se sentent naturelles, intuitives et fluides sur différents appareils. Ma passion est de concevoir des expériences numériques qui non seulement sont esthétiques, mais fonctionnent également sans effort, rendant les interactions plus fluides et agréables.

zh.description: 我是一名拥有8年经验的UX设计师，专注于打造自然、直观且跨设备无缝的用户界面。我的热情在于设计数字体验，不仅外观出色，而且功能流畅，使交互更加顺畅和愉悦。
